Those two are the only figures a balance decision can rest on. The other Created figures say little, for the reasons R4082000 gives: - **Win rate** is the made seats' raw rate, which carries the shared play selection. - **Used, Not used and Used vs not used** carry the played-delta bias, and a summoned token has no unused side at all. - **Used Radiant and Used normal** split that same biased side.
